sample_text: Greetings, traveler. What brings you to these lands this day?
instruct: Gender: male. Age: late thirties. Role: tormented ghost alchemist. Pitch: low, hollow baritone with a raspy edge. Pace: slow, tremulous, with heavy pauses that echo his agony. Emotion: profound sorrow, self-blame, haunted resignation. Characteristics: breathy, thin, with a metallic undertone from spectral energy. Use case: fantasy RPG dialogue in a haunted ruin or spectral tavern.
